newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Euro-MPs approves Duisenberg to head EMI.
newsitem.headline: Euro-MPs approves Duisenberg to head EMI.

text.p: The European Parliament endorsed by show of hands on Thursday the appointment of Wim Duisenberg as president of the European Monetary Institute, the forerunner of the European Central Bank (ECB).
Duisenberg, who is currently the governor of the Dutch central bank, will take over from Alexander Lamfalussy on July 1, 1997.
Euro-MPs also agreed that Lamfalussy's mandate, which should have ended on January 1, 1997, should be extended for six months until 30 June 1997.
Under EU rules, the parliament could have blocked both moves.
